checks.detail: The computer starts in UEFI mode, which paguro needs.
WSL2 is installed: distributions are installed inside it.
200 GB free on C:, enough for a Linux image.
BitLocker is on: Linux is protected the same way as Windows.
A TPM is present: Linux can unlock with it, like Windows.
Secure Boot is on: every step of starting Linux is verified.
The Secure Boot database could not be read.
Fast Startup is on: Windows' drive stays half-open, so Linux can only read it.
